verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Paddle pushes real-time webhook notifications to your server. They also document security: a `Paddle-Signature` header with secret-key verification, an IP allowlist, and signature-verifier helpers in the Node and Python SDKs. For AI-native use, the hosted MCP server can configure webhooks and simulate events, agent skills cover webhook integration, and the Next.js starter kit syncs data via webhooks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of selecting or subscribing to specific event types and of delivery and retry semantics, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
